content.short: Crypto APIs is a blockchain infrastructure provider offering a toolkit for developers to build wallets, exchanges, payments, lending, custodial, and accounting.
content.description: Crypto APIs delivers blockchain infrastructure solutions for the cryptocurrency and blockchain sector, offering a comprehensive toolkit that helps developers build a wide range of applications—from crypto wallets and exchanges to payment rails and wallet services. The platform also supports lending, custodial services, and accounting workflows, reflecting its versatility across DeFi, fintech, and enterprise use cases. In short, Crypto APIs is a flexible platform that accelerates innovation by providing essential infrastructure for diverse blockchain projects.
